subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official bundled qwen provider/auth surface after the generated catalog repair, or should this remain an external plugin path?
rationale: The implementation fits the qwen provider boundary and has live proof, but it adds public provider, auth-choice, env-var, endpoint, and catalog contracts that require maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
options.body: Repair the generated catalog/reference drift, rebase onto current main, and merge the Token Plan provider as an official qwen setup path.

options.title: Route To External Plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Token Plan support as an external provider plugin if maintainers do not want another bundled Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Defer For Stronger Vendor Proof
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers have stronger vendor documentation or account-level proof for provider ids, regions, and catalog stability.

recommendation.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
recommendation.body: Repair the generated catalog/reference drift, rebase onto current main, and merge the Token Plan provider as an official qwen setup path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the qwen provider surface and is already assigned to the live PR.
